name: o28269
description:
To retrieve the requested resource, issue a GET request over HTTPS using the credentials **user:password**. The target server is **example.com** on port **443**, and the call should be directed to the path **/api/v1/resources**. Include the query string **id=123&sort=asc** to specify the record and ordering.

The complete URI you will need is:

https://user:password@example.com:443/api/v1/resources?id=123&sort=asc#section2

The fragment **section2** points to the second section of the returned document, where the relevant details are displayed.
